\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{circuitikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{circuitikz}[american]
    \draw (0,0) -- (0,-6);
    \draw (4,.9) -- (4,-5.6);
    \draw (0,0) to[pR, name=H, wiper pos=.2] (4,0);
    \draw (0,-3) to[pR, name=M, wiper pos=.3, mirror] (4,-1.4);
    \ctikzset{european resistors}
    \draw (0,-6) to[pR, name=I, wiper pos=.75, mirror, invert] (4,-4.4);
    \draw[blue] (H.wiper) -- (4,.9);
    \draw[red] (M.wiper) -- (0,-4.1);
    \draw[green!50!black] (I.wiper) -- (4,-5.6);
\end{circuitikz}
\end{document}
